static_traits.name: Chen Ze
static_traits.family_status: Mother of two sons, living with husband in a house with a yard
static_traits.social_status: Has a supportive husband and close friends; friends appreciate the art, but she finds it hard to share 'worthlessness' with them, interpersonal support not yet fully used
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy or counseling received before; no similar psychological problems in the past
static_traits.language_features: Neutral attitude; clear and organized expression; able to describe the problem's origins and effects specifically; fairly cooperative, willing to try new methods; tending to focus on the negative when discussing sales and value

basic_info.main_problem: Strong 'worthlessness' about one's art from believing 'no one buys my work'; the feeling appeared and intensified about a year ago after a heavily invested series failed to sell, continuously affecting creative motivation and physical/mental state.
basic_info.core_demands: Hoping these feelings of worthlessness will stop hindering artistic expression and mental health; 'I just want to feel Good about my art again'; willing to set concrete goals (such as exhibiting, building an online store) and test and revise negative beliefs through behavioral experiments.
growth_experiences: About a year ago, a series the client invested great effort in failed to sell, and this failure became the starting point of 'worthlessness'. Stress was initially moderate; the client thought the cause might relate to family financial pressure (needing to contribute financially to the family). Over time the problem escalated: Increased self-doubt, Decline in creative motivation; each completed work brought worry it would not sell, and disappointment; persistently focusing on 'no sales', ignoring positive feedback received. The client tried art fairs and online promotion, but sales still did not improve, further Reinforcement the negative beliefs.

core_beliefs: If my work is not bought, I as a person have no value

special_situations.event: After completing a new work, Anticipating it will not sell
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If a work is not bought, it proves the work is utterly worthless, and I am not worthy either
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles participation in art exhibitions and online promotion, or avoids sharing real feelings with family and friends to reduce the risk of being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It will not sell, my work is not worth money

special_situations.event: About a year ago, a series of works into which much effort was invested failed to sell
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One failure means future failures too; the market will not accept my style
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Lowers creative motivation while continuing external promotion to 'prove oneself'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am destined never to sell

special_situations.event: Receiving positive feedback but the other has not yet bought the work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only purchase counts as real recognition; verbal praise does not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating and belittling positive feedback, telling oneself they are just being polite
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just being polite, the work is not worth buying

special_situations.event: Increased family financial stress, needing income from art creation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot earn money with art, I am incompetent, a useless family member
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: On one hand forcing oneself to promote more actively, on the other Withdrawing interpersonally to avoid discussing sales and finances
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am dragging my family down

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be truly recognized and seen (hoping their art is valued and confirmed through purchase)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being rejected and negated as a 'useless person', and burdening the family
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of safety by downplaying emotions and withdrawing
Avoiding hope being dashed again by denying or belittling appreciation

object_relations.object_representation: The outside world (market/others) are harsh judges; only purchasing counts as recognition

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When others appreciate the work but have not yet bought it
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Understanding the other as superficially polite but actually rejecting and negating (projecting one's own Self-doubt onto the other's motives)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responding in a defensive and skeptical tone, emphasizing 'they are just being polite', downplaying emotional expression and quickly shifting the topic.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When family mentions financial contributions or asks about sales
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Views the other as a judge who measures self-worth by the single dimension of 'how much money is earned'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Explains using market and objective conditions, with a steady tone, avoiding expressing feelings of shame or fear and keeping emotional distance.

manifestations: Binds artistic value to 'whether it is purchased' as the only standard
Experiencing self and work 'worthlessness' when sales are lacking
Ignoring positive feedback, focusing on the fact of not yet selling
Withdrawing interpersonally due to unease and worthlessness
Hard to share true feelings with a supportive spouse and friends

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Internalizing the market standard of 'only bought has value' in an undigested way as the sole criterion for measuring self and work worth
Self-demand to prove value through sales (implicit 'should/must' rule)

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Faced with others' appreciation, quickly returns to the topic of 'lack of sales' to avoid contact with support
When talking about emotions, shifts to objective market factors, reducing direct contact with shame and fear

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Withdrawing in interpersonal interactions, unwilling to share inner unease and vulnerability

positive_force: Having a supportive husband and friends, Good Social support foundation
Actively seeks professional help, highly cooperative, willing to try behavioral experiments
Already has some experience with external actions (exhibitions and online promotion)
Having sustained creative ability and willingness
negative_force: Cognitive patterns of catastrophizing, overgeneralization, mental filtering, and negating positive feedback
Black-and-white thinking that binds self-worth entirely to sales results
Anxiety and Self-deprecation from financial pressure
Disturbed sleep and appetite eroding physical and mental resources

target_behavior.behavior: Immediately after completing a work, catastrophizing worry and self-deprecation appear
antecedent: Just finished a piece of work
Observing no purchase behavior in the short term
target_behavior.core_reason: Binding self and art worth solely to 'whether it sells', driven by Catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the experience of failure and shame, trying to lower expectations and potential disappointment through preemptive negation
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in creative motivation, Low mood, disrupted sleep and appetite

target_behavior.behavior: Negating positive feedback, only focusing on not yet selling (mental filtering)
antecedent: Receiving others' praise but no purchase yet
Lack of orders when browsing social media or online stores
target_behavior.core_reason: Over-reliance on external validation and mental filtering, believing non-purchase does not count as recognition
target_behavior.function: Maintains a negative self-schema to avoid the pain of 'hope, then disappointment again'
target_behavior.consequence: Self-worth drops further and the quality of interpersonal interaction declines

target_behavior.behavior: Social withdrawal (not sharing unease and Self-doubt with family)
antecedent: When family discusses financial contributions or asks about sales
Feelings of failure and shame when encountering poor sales
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing judgment and negation, worrying that exposing vulnerability will cause Relationship tension
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential conflict and negation, maintaining short-term safety
target_behavior.consequence: Tense family relationships, support resources unable to be effectively used, Increased sense of loneliness

antecedent: Repeatedly worrying at night that works will not sell
When facing financial pressure and self-deprecation
target_behavior.core_reason: Persistent anxiety and negative cognitions triggering physiological reactions and disrupted routines
target_behavior.consequence: Worsened physical state, decreased creative efficiency, further impaired emotional regulation
